title: AI now steers shopping and memory costs squeeze PC pricing: act on both
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Google launched Universal Cart; Best Buy joined TikTok Shop; Counterpoint reports record PC price inflation from memory shortage.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream and Google's Universal Cart moves the cart into AI
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Google opened Universal Cart in Search and Gemini. Our product feeds and data must be ready for holiday 2026.

points.headline: Memory shortage is driving record PC price inflation into 2027
points.detail: Counterpoint cites record PC price inflation and DigiTimes sees DRAM and NAND prices rising into Q4. We should plan pricing, promotions and inventory for tighter margins.

points.headline: Best Buy joins TikTok Shop, opening a new electronics channel for the holidays
points.detail: Best Buy is selling on TikTok Shop for its biggest holiday season yet. We should test our presence and promotions on social commerce.

points.headline: Online holiday demand is growing and shoppers want flexible financing
points.detail: Adobe forecasts $275.1B in US online holiday sales (+6.7%); Amazon UK added BNPL via Affirm. We should review deal depth and instalment options.
